_README: Volumes/extents of the Visible Human female lower-limb bone labels (scripts/vhf_lower_limb_bones.py) and the legs->torso block registration. Derived data.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female, IDC series af18f5e4 (femur-to-toes CT) and b9cf8e7a (torso CT, TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 femur labels for the registration).

registration.method: block continuity across the torso/legs junction (see script docstring); no femoral head in the legs block
